title: Unit Event — Deep Dark for Light — Episode1 The ArcLand Show Contest

meta.Event Outline: On the last day of the workshop, Wonderlands×Showtime learn about the upcoming ArcLand Show Contest, and they decide to compete. Faced with the challenging role of a prince beset by despair, Tsukasa becomes keenly aware of the gap between himself and Asahi.

rows.Line: ArcLand - Workshop Venue

rows.Speaker: Workshop Host
rows.Line: And that officially wraps up this workshop. Thank you all very much.

rows.Speaker: Workshop Host
rows.Line: Particularly thanks to the help of our guest lecturers, this has proven to be a deeply rewarding experience for us all.

rows.Speaker: Workshop Host
rows.Line: I hope what you've learned here will prove useful to you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Today was the final day of ArcLand's workshop.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Not only was it an opportunity to learn from world-class instructors, but it was a valuable chance to interact with ArcLand's cast as well.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (It is a shame that such fulfilling days are coming to an end...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (But we mustn't stop moving forward! We will take what we've learned here and make it fuel for our continued growth!)

rows.Speaker: Workshop Host
rows.Line: Oh, however... One more thing, before we part ways.

rows.Speaker: Workshop Host
rows.Line: I have a very important announcement for you all.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: An important announcement?

rows.Speaker: Workshop Host
rows.Line: In the near future, we will be hosting the ArcLand Show Contest.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The ArcLand...Show Contest?

rows.Speaker: Workshop Host
rows.Line: ArcLand is currently working on an initiative to create new shows.

rows.Speaker: Workshop Host
rows.Line: Ordinarily, new productions would be focused on ArcLand's cast and crew...

rows.Speaker: Workshop Host
rows.Line: But as I'm sure you're all aware, we here at ArcLand—especially the members of the Center Theatre—have made it our goal to create “shows that bring the world together”.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Shows that bring the world together...)

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: I'd already had some interest in ArcLand since it was famous for being a theme park that put on world-class shows.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: So, I came up with the idea of putting on shows at the Center Theatre that bring the world together.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Shows that bring the world together...?

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Haha. I guess that needs more explaining...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: In other words, ArcLand is currently working to do shows like the one Tom showed me.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: For all those people out there who are somehow surviving but are unable to smile...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: The cast of the Center Theatre plans to do shows around the world just for them.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (This is what Asahi was talking about.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I do recall him saying they were laying the groundwork for that goal...)

rows.Speaker: Workshop Host
rows.Line: Of course, to achieve this goal, we'll need many brilliant actors.

rows.Speaker: Workshop Host
rows.Line: And the best way to find brilliant actors is to create a space for talented young people to learn and gain experience.

rows.Speaker: Workshop Host
rows.Line: That's why we decided to open participation to unaffiliated troupes, and present this opportunity in the form of a contest.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I see. This fits with ArcLand's usual style of doing things.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (They aren't simply focused on a box office take. This contest stands to improve the industry as a whole... It's an investment in the future.)

rows.Speaker: Workshop Host
rows.Line: The troupe that wins this contest will be given a two-week run at the Center Theatre here in ArcLand.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
...!
A run at the Center Theatre?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Despite operating as part of a theme park, the Center Theatre is one of the most prestigious theatres in Japan.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I felt lucky enough to stand on its stage during the workshop... I can only imagine the experience would be on another level with an audience.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (If we could perform on that stage, it would be an opportunity for growth unlike any we've experienced...!)

rows.Speaker: Workshop Host
rows.Line: The judges for the contest will be ArcLand's production committee...

rows.Speaker: Workshop Host
rows.Line: And Mr. Koryu Sakaki here will also participate as a special judge.

rows.Speaker: Sakaki
rows.Line: That's right, you're not rid of me just yet.

rows.Speaker: Sakaki
rows.Line: Oh, right, one more thing from me.

rows.Speaker: Sakaki
rows.Line: Maybe you've all guessed by now, but there might be something special lined up for anyone who produces particularly good results in the contest.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Something special?
Do you think he means like a parade?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I really don't think that's where this is going, no...

rows.Speaker: Sakaki
rows.Line: I'd like to get my hands on some of this sparkling new talent too, after all.

rows.Speaker: Sakaki
rows.Line: I'm not making any promises, but who knows? I might drop you a little invitation. Maybe to one of my productions overseas.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Overseas...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Which means...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (This could be a first step toward the world stage...!)

rows.Speaker: Sakaki
rows.Line: So break a leg, won't you?

rows.Speaker: Workshop Host
rows.Line: The full details of the contest will be posted to the ArcLand website tomorrow at noon, so please be sure to check them out.

rows.Speaker: Workshop Host
rows.Line: Once again, thank you all for your participation. We look forward to your future endeavors.
Scramble Crossing
se_walk_women_001_4

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Everyone!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I know this is sudden, right after the workshop, but I have a matter to discuss with you! It concerns—

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The contest, right?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm! W-Well, yes—

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Of course we're entering, right, Tsukasa?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh?! O-Of course we are! This is a chance to step onto the world stage, and—

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And it would be a shame to let it pass us by. Is that about right?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Let... Let...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Let me finish a sentence!!!
You're hardly leaving any lines for me!!!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe, apologies.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm just as happy as you are to have received this opportunity, after all, and I couldn't help myself.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Same. It sounds like a great chance to see just what we can do now.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And if everything goes well, it could even bring us closer to our dreams. There's no way we could pass this up.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! I really, really want to learn how things work behind the scenes for such a big theatre, too!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let's win the contest and take a flying leap toward our dreams!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Honestly... I'm certainly in no position to talk, but I don't know if this is bravery or recklessness...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But that's the spirit! I can see we're all motivated!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: In that case, I have nothing further to say!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wonderlands×Showtime! We're going to enter that contest... And we're going to win!

rows.Speaker: Nene, Emu & Rui
rows.Line: Yeah!!
